title: Chapter 1222 - 32: Breakthrough! Chaos Realm (Seeking Subscription)
content:
Chapter 1222 - 32: Breakthrough! Chaos Realm (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1222: Chapter 32: Breakthrough! Chaos Realm (Seeking Subscription)

"Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar?"

"It’s the second Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar!"

The many Supreme Heaven Lords immediately began to rush towards the source of the strange fluctuations with all their might.

When the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar emerged, everyone was reluctant to fight to the death with the Da Fu Ancient Country since there were still two more Gigantic Core Heaven Pillars yet to emerge.

They could afford to wait a little longer.

But for the second Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar... no Supreme Heaven Lord was willing to give it up easily. Even though the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar ended up in the hands of the Galaxy Venerate, Fu Xu Heaven Lord would certainly make a move to seize the second Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar again...

Some top Supreme Heaven Lords also planned to try their hand at a fight.

Even the Xuanyin Ancient Country, which had long given up the struggle, didn’t mind making a move. If this Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar fell into their hands, they could completely offer the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the Da Fu Ancient Country a higher price.

...

"This Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar is definitely ours, the Barbaric Wilderness Country’s." A towering figure tore through time and space, rushing quickly.

...

"Galaxy, the second Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar has emerged."

The Red Flame Venerate looked at Lin Yuan and quickly spoke.

"Mm."

Lin Yuan nodded, "I’ll go have a look."

As the words fell.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared from where he was.

...

In almost a fraction of a breath.

Around the newly emerged towering Heaven Pillar, several figures suddenly appeared.

First, Fu Xu Heaven Lord, followed by Lin Yuan, and lastly, a towering figure.

"Not the first to arrive?"

Lin Yuan glanced at Fu Xu Heaven Lord. The location where this Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar emerged was a good half a treasure land’s distance from the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar.

So his speed in arriving still lagged slightly behind Fu Xu Heaven Lord.

The other was closer to this Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar.

"Galaxy Venerate, you’ve already obtained one Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar. Still planning to seize another?" Fu Xu Heaven Lord smiled at Lin Yuan.

The towering figure nearby also watched the two strongest Venerables from afar.

"I’ll give it a try."

Lin Yuan said casually.

If he could secure this Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar, it would certainly be better.

"Man Kun, I suggest you head to the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar and wait there."

Fu Xu Heaven Lord suddenly turned his head, looking at the towering figure beside him.

This towering figure was the leading top Supreme Heaven Lord of the Barbaric Wilderness Country. At this moment, his aura was strong and penetrated through time and space, faintly showing signs of confronting the two strongest Venerables, evidently having activated the Ancient Country’s foundational war tool.

"Head to the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar and wait there?"

Man Kun Venerable’s expression changed slightly, looking at Lin Yuan next to him.

The implication of Fu Xu Heaven Lord was easy to understand. Once Fu Xu Heaven Lord and Galaxy Venerate started fighting, he could fully take advantage of Galaxy Venerate being restrained by Fu Xu Heaven Lord to seize the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar.

Lin Yuan glanced at Fu Xu Heaven Lord.

At the same time, he faintly felt the aura of several top Supreme Heaven Lords nearing the Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar he had refined.

Once he was restrained here, the Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar he refined would be in danger.

Why did Red Flame Venerate voluntarily give up and let Fu Xu Heaven Lord take the first Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar?

It was because Fu Xu Heaven Lord, who already occupied one Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar, basically had no ability to continue occupying the second one.

Fu Xu Heaven Lord could indeed send out avatars, but the strength of these avatars was far inferior to his true body’s main power and likewise couldn’t hold on.

As for carrying multiple main battle avatars inside? Not to mention how difficult it is to cultivate a main battle avatar, even bringing in two or three main battle avatars would struggle to face such a situation.

Main battle avatars, avatars alike, and even the true body all share one conscious mind.

In this scenario, the strength maintained by the mind’s will at the same time is limited. If one side occupies too much mental focus, the other side’s strength will inevitably be weakened.

...

Actually, with Lin Yuan’s power and reserves, he could completely guard two Gigantic Core Heaven Pillars.

That would involve recondensing the Taiyin and Taiyang two Primordial Spirits within the treasure land, merging them into the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit differs from avatars and main battle avatars in that it doesn’t occupy Lin Yuan’s additional mental focus, meaning both the Taiji Primordial Spirit and his true body could exert maximum combat power simultaneously.

However, the Taiji Primordial Spirit was Lin Yuan’s trump card. Even if it allowed him to occupy the second Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar, it wouldn’t enable him to refine more Core Heaven Pillars than the Da Fu Ancient Country.

Deploying the Taiji Primordial Spirit prematurely would alert the Supreme Heaven Lords of the major ancient countries, hindering Lin Yuan’s following strategies and maneuvers.

The impact would be minimal.

Furthermore, even with the deployment of the Taiji Primordial Spirit, once the third Gigantic Core Heaven Pillar emerged, it still wouldn’t prevent Fu Xu Heaven Pillar from occupying and refining it.

According to Lin Yuan’s plan, if, by the struggle for the treasure land’s end, he hasn’t broken through yet, he would then form the Taiji Primordial Spirit, occupy, and refine more Core Heaven Pillars in the shortest time possible.

His true body and Taiji Primordial Spirit roughly equate to the combat power of two strongest Venerables, striking at the last moment when Fu Xu Heaven Lord has no time to react or respond, it’s highly possible he could seize the treasure land in the end.

If he still fails to seize the treasure land, only then would Lin Yuan consider the terms of the Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country, securing the treasure land first before proceeding.

This is also why Lin Yuan didn’t directly reject the offerings from the Xuanyin Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country.

"Good idea."

Lin Yuan looked at Fu Xu Heaven Lord, shook his head slightly, and said, "But you disgust me, so I’ve decided to let this treasure land go to the Barbaric Wilderness Country."

"Galaxy Venerate, you?"

Fu Xu Venerate’s expression slightly changed.

In the next moment.

The Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Diagram expanded infinitely, enveloping Fu Xu Venerate within it.

"Hahaha, thank you, Galaxy Venerate!"

Man Kun Venerable was overjoyed, knowing that Galaxy Venerate intended to hold off Fu Xu Venerate, giving him time to refine this gigantic core heavenly pillar.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh.

Without any hindrance, Man Kun Venerable instantly refined the gigantic core heavenly pillar.

At this time, Lin Yuan also retracted the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Diagram, glancing at Fu Xu Venerate, whose expression was gloomy.

"Since this gigantic core heavenly pillar now has an owner, I’ll take my leave first." Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared and returned to the vicinity of the gigantic core heavenly pillar he had refined.

At this moment, many top-tier Peak Venerables were approaching, with Red Flame Venerable and Venerable Guanglie on high alert.

Only when Lin Yuan reappeared did the Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country breathe a sigh of relief.

"Galaxy, you did the right thing." Red Flame Venerable also received the latest intelligence about the second gigantic core heavenly pillar.

Although Fu Xu Venerate posed a deadly threat to Lin Yuan, Lin Yuan had choices. He took the initiative to hold off Fu Xu Venerate, benefiting Thunder Venerate, thereby venting some frustration.

"Hahaha, Galaxy Venerate, no matter who this treasure land belongs to, I’ll treat you to a drink when we return." At this moment, Lin Yuan received a message from Man Kun Venerable.

"Alright." Lin Yuan nodded, "Can you hold off Fu Xu Venerate?"

"No problem." Man Kun Venerable patted his chest with confidence.

...

In front of the second gigantic core heavenly pillar, Fu Xu Venerate stared at Man Kun Venerable standing beside the heavenly pillar.

"Fu Xu, if you attack me with all your might, aren’t you afraid that Da Fu Ancient Country’s other refined core heavenly pillars will be seized?"

In front of Man Kun Venerable, an oscillating heart appeared, with surging power spreading out, guarding the space-time around the gigantic core heavenly pillar.

"Hmph!"

Fu Xu Venerate pondered for a long time and finally turned to leave.

If he were to exert his full strength here, the Galaxy Venerate of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would most likely seize the opportunity to plunder the core heavenly pillars refined by the Da Fu Ancient Country.

The core heavenly pillars occupied by Da Fu Ancient Country already surpass those of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, usually under his own guard, leaving no opportunity for Galaxy Venerate.

But if he were detained here, Galaxy Venerate certainly wouldn’t stand idly by.

Thus, even if he could repel the already refined gigantic core heavenly pillar holder Man Kun Venerable, some of the previously refined core heavenly pillars would certainly fall into the hands of Galaxy Venerate.

In such a losing deal, no matter how angry Fu Xu Venerate was, he wouldn’t choose to engage.

Watching Fu Xu Venerate leave.

Man Kun Venerable felt a slight relief in his heart.

"Man Kun." A smile appeared on the faces of other Peak Venerables from the Barbaric Wilderness Country as they approached.

"This time, capturing this gigantic core heavenly pillar is all thanks to Galaxy Venerate," Man Kun Venerable said truthfully.

If it weren’t for Galaxy Venerate holding off Fu Xu Venerate and battling this Strongest Venerable, Man Kun Venerable had no assurance of success.

Galaxy Venerate could have chosen to retreat to the gigantic core heavenly pillar he had refined, but instead, he chose to delay Fu Xu Venerate, which Man Kun Venerable was deeply grateful for.

"If this time, our Barbaric Wilderness Country had no hope of capturing this treasure land, I would trade all core heavenly pillars to Galaxy Venerate."

Man Kun Venerable thought to himself, purely because Galaxy Venerate helped him this time and he bore a grudge against Da Fu Ancient Country.

...

Quickly.

The news of the second gigantic core heavenly pillar being refined by Man Kun Venerable of the Thunderclap Ancient Country swiftly spread among the many Peak Venerables in the treasure land.

"Man Kun Venerable refined the second gigantic core heavenly pillar?"

"Haha, I know the inside story. Galaxy Venerate deliberately held off Fu Xu Venerate to allow Man Kun Venerable to refine it."

"Isn’t Galaxy Venerate afraid of completely offending the Da Fu Ancient Country?"

"What does it matter if they get offended? With Galaxy Venerate’s strength, they’re not afraid of Da Fu Ancient Country."

"That’s true, after all, being the Strongest Venerable..."

.....

The Peak Venerables conversed among themselves, and many top-tier Peak Venerables intended to vie for the gigantic core heavenly pillar, but it was already settled before they could arrive.

.....

Time slowly passed.

In the blink of an eye, six hundred years went by.

During this time, the third gigantic core heavenly pillar emerged, and Fu Xu Venerate left in anger, successfully capturing the final gigantic core heavenly pillar.

Thus, the three gigantic core heavenly pillars within this treasure land were respectively owned by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the Barbaric Wilderness Country, and the Da Fu Ancient Country.

And with the emergence of the three gigantic core heavenly pillars, the atmosphere between the six ancient countries within the treasure land began to grow subtle. The closer it got to the final stage of the treasure land’s contention, the more tense it became, with the most intense battles potentially erupting at any moment.

Meanwhile.

In the Chaos Void, on the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, comprehending the Dao of Chaos Yin Yang Taiji.

"Hmm?"

Suddenly, Lin Yuan opened his eyes, sensing his aura gradually becoming perfected and at its limit.

"I have grown to the extreme of the dominator realm in every aspect."

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful, then gently exhaled:

"It’s time to step into the Chaos Realm."
